summary.text: Regina Weiss is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives serving her third term for District 5, which includes Northwest Detroit, Oak Park and all of Royal Oak Township.
She is a former teacher in the Detroit Public Schools Community District and a former Oak Park City Council member.

paragraphs.text: Originally from Indiana, Weiss attended Valparaiso University before moving to Michigan to begin her career as a teacher in the Detroit Public Schools Community District.
She served on the Oak Park City Council until her election to the House in 2020.
